title: Cherrypicking Protocol for Seeding
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create input CSV file
steps.instruction: Prepare a CSV file whose columns are exactly: Original plate position in OT-2 workspace, Original position, Picking volume (ul), Destination plate position, Destination position, Seeding volume, Trashing volume, Cell medium original plate, Cell medium destination plate. Include up to 2 source plates and up to 2 destination plates. Example rows are: 1.1,B1,20,2.1,B1,20,0,40,40; 1.1,B5,30,2.1,B2,20,10,30,40; 1.1,C16,50,2.2,B1,30,20,10,30; 1.2,B6,10,2.2,B2,10,0,50,50; 1.2,D4,20,2.2,B3,10,10,40,50; 1.2,E5,30,2.2,B4,20,10,30,40. You may download a template file from https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/04552f/ex.csv.

steps.title: Insert CSV into protocol script
steps.instruction: Open the downloaded Python protocol file, locate line 17, and replace the placeholder with your CSV content as a multi‑line string, assigning it to the variable `INPUT_CSV`.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to `More` → `Custom Labware` → `Add Labware` and upload any required labware definition files (JSON format, .json extensions).

steps.title: Upload protocol script to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, open the `Protocol` tab and upload the edited protocol file (Python extension, .py).

steps.title: Arrange deck as per deck map
steps.instruction: Place the source plates, destination plates, tip racks, and any other labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for all labware, tip racks, and the pipette. Consult the OT App support articles for calibration tips if needed.
